title: Places in Town Foundations
welcome_lead: Learn the names of the main places you find in a Spanish town.
meta_desc: GCSE Spanish foundations adventure on places in town vocabulary.
final_note: ¡Perfecto! You can now name the key places en mi pueblo.

walkthroughs.body_html: Many shop names end in -ería and are feminine: la panadería (bakery), la carnicería (butcher's), la frutería (fruit shop), la librería (bookshop). Use la before them.

Hay means both 'there is' and 'there are'. It never changes form. En mi pueblo hay un cine y una iglesia (In my town there is a cinema and a church). Negative: No hay supermercado (There is no supermarket).
En means 'in/at'. Vivo en Madrid (I live in Madrid). Estoy en el café (I am at the café). Combine with hay: En el centro hay muchas tiendas (In the centre there are many shops).
